title: New Jersey Drops Coinbase Staking Order After Three Years
summary: Bitcoin Magazine New Jersey Drops Coinbase Staking Order After Three Years New Jersey’s securities regulator has rescinded its 2023 cease-and-desist order and $5 million penalty against Coinbase’s staking service. This post New Jersey Drops Coinbase Staking Order After Three Years first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
